webgpu.note: the last frame is filled by the generated rock cliff and grass hill: GL and WebGPU filter those textures differently (19.1 to 19.8% of pixels differ by more than 16, every one inside a textured face, measured 2026-10-27; edges, sky, characters and HUD match), state exact on every host; maxArea still catches a surface one backend misses

note: camera stability, the way a person plays: one pad through title, join and start, then stand, walk, stop, jump and stand while the drawn camera is measured every frame (g.camgate: frames at rest, at-rest frames that moved over 1 mm, frames in motion, frames in motion with a jump over 0.6 m or a jerk over 8 cm). At rest it must not move at all; in motion it must stay smooth. The control brings back the boss landing that shook the screen from anywhere in the world (COOP_SHAKE_BUG, native): its g.camgate must differ.
